answers.core: It's directly a missing piece of information in the shader that can't be changed other than by modifying the engine.
answers.workaround: There are several ways of getting around the problem, such as passing the missing information by [uniform](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/57401#issuecomment-1411865325), or using a particular [vertexShader](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/57401#issuecomment-1998355278) to change the UVs, but I don't think this is desirable.

title: Expose built-in region information: Misunderstanding of UV for canvas_item with region
